title: Tech Note: New List Box Features in 4D v11 SQL – Part 2
author: Tom Fitch, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: List Boxes remain a core, actively maintained 4D form object, so the underlying concept here is still directly relevant, though the specific v11 SQL-era command set and data-source model described has been substantially extended and partly superseded by later list box enhancements and ORDA-based data binding.
related_updates: 4D's List Box object has continued to receive major feature updates in versions well beyond v11 SQL, including collection- and entity-selection-based data sources introduced alongside ORDA (2018+)
Modern list box data binding commonly uses ORDA collections/entity selections rather than the specific v11 SQL-era commands shown in this note
